cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — standing; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a stairwell landing with a tall window — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — seated sideways on a stool or bench
